rule: Candidates with a local maximum within 1001 ±5 cm-1 whose intensity is at least 10% of that spectrum's maximum.

margin.interpretation: For polystyrene 1001 is the strongest peak (100%); for PET, 1000 is 30% of the maximum. A threshold above 30% drops PET, so the threshold must be fixed in the question or the grading criterion.

tolerance: Set match. Inventing entries not in the library is wrong.
issue: A threshold of 30% or more reduces the answer to [REF05_polystyrene] only. State "at least 10% of the maximum" in the grading criterion.
